name: MInecraft: Journey to the Great Shiai
summary: Embark on an Epic journey to the Great Shia! Recruit eight Judo Champions, each representing a core Judo value: Courage, Respect, Modesty, Friendship, Honour, Sincerity, Self-control, and Politeness. Collect powerful cards and master your Judo deck, solve quests, and embody the spirit of Judo!
